'''Kuna's Scale''' was a [[supergiant]] [[Star/Legends|star]] that the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]], considered to be part of the [[Kuna constellation]]. [[Kuna systems|Most]] of the stars in the constellation were located in the Moddell [[Sector/Legends|sector]] near Maya Kovel; however, Kuna's Scale, [[Kuna's Gullet]], and [[Kuna's Heart]] were not. Despite their apparent proximity to the others in the constellation, the three bright stars were located in either adjacent sectors or [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="gamer9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kuna's Scale was mentioned in the article "[[Endor and the Moddell Sector]]," published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="gamer9" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> [[Jason Fry]], author of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' and its [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] follow-up appendix of star systems, stated that Kuna's Gullet, Heart and Scale were excluded due to them being local names for existing stars.<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC_discussion.jpg|author=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2015-06-30}}</ref>
